summary.intent: Manage a multi-phase milestone (cipher-box phases 28-33) from a single terminal using the GSD manager: execute pending phases, resolve PR reviews, simplify code, and advance the milestone to near-completion.
summary.outcome: Phases 29-32 all executed and PRs created (#386-388); 4 rounds of PR review comments resolved across Phase 29-31 PRs; code simplified for all three phases; 73 new SDK unit tests added; Phase 32 FUSE async redesign shipped (O(N×10s) blocking → O(10s) concurrent).

repo: The established async pattern in the FUSE crate is channel-based: PendingContent enum, mpsc channel pair (tx/rx), dedup HashSet — Phase 32 mirrored this exactly for FilePointers.
drain_refresh_completions() in crates/fuse/src/lib.rs was blocking the FUSE thread with block_with_timeout() per FilePointer — root cause of Finder 'connection lost' errors with many files.
unenrollIpns() in apps/api/src/ipns/ipns.service.ts returned void, causing unenrollBatch to always report 0 totalUnenrolled regardless of actual deletions.
registerFaroTransport uses mutable array injection (loggerTransports.push()) as an intentional design to integrate with Phase 28 logger at runtime — not a bug.
faro.api.resetUser() exists as a dedicated clean API for clearing user identity — cleaner than setUser(null as unknown as ...) cast.
Phase 31 planning deferred D-09 (bin purgeExpired migration) and D-15 (bin.service.ts retirement) — bin.service.ts already deprecated with only 2 consumers, SDK equivalents exist.
scripts/check-api-client.sh:42 uses git diff --quiet intentionally — removing it would cause false positives since you cannot detect 'api:generate was never run' at the git level.
@grafana/faro-web-tracing supports ignoreNetworkEvents and ignoreXhrBody options to prevent capturing sensitive request/response bodies in telemetry.

code.finding: drain_refresh_completions() called block_with_timeout() sequentially per FilePointer on the FUSE thread — replaced with tokio::spawn() async tasks in Phase 32.
unenrollIpns() returned void; changed to return number (affected rows) so unenrollBatch can sum actual deletions instead of overcounting.
Global regex with /g flag (HEX_KEY_PATTERN) needs lastIndex reset BEFORE .test(), not after — stale lastIndex from prior calls causes missed matches on alternating calls.
SENSITIVE_KEYS list must include 'email' explicitly — email scrubbing is separate from the hex-pattern regex path.
isDescendantOf(node, node) should return true (a node is a descendant of itself) — initial implementation returned false for self-identity.
isForbiddenError() was missing the response.status check path that isConflictError() had — Axios error objects nest status under both error.status and error.response.status.
hideSharedItem callback was missing p.setSharedItems and p.setError in its useCallback dependency array — could silently use stale closures.
E2E test was accessing private SDK field via ctx casting — replaced with createAxiosInstance() exported from @cipherbox/api-client.

workflow: Stale worktrees from merged PRs must be manually removed (git worktree remove) — they block branch checkout and pollute worktree list.
Planning files (.planning/ROADMAP.md, STATE.md) conflict frequently across feature branches — always take main's version as it's the canonical state.
pnpm add must be run from the correct package directory; running from repo root without -w/--filter does not persist to package.json or lockfile.
Prettier formatting issues should be caught before committing — caused a CI failure on Phase 31 PR that required a separate fix commit.
Background agents use isolated worktrees that hold branch locks — must remove worktree before switching to that branch in the main repo.
When multiple branches have diverged planning files, cherry-pick is cleaner than merge for selectively bringing in context commits.
The /simplify workflow runs three parallel review agents (reuse, quality, efficiency) and aggregates findings — false positives should be noted and skipped, not argued.
Global regexes (/g flag) are stateful in JS — always reset lastIndex before calling .test() if the regex instance is reused across calls.

friction: Multiple rounds of merge conflicts in .planning/ ROADMAP.md across branches — happened 3+ times requiring manual resolution each time.
Phase 29 worktree had the Phase 31 branch checked out, blocking checkout in main repo — required worktree removal before switching branches.
pnpm add for @grafana/faro-web-tracing ran in wrong directory, silently not persisting to package.json — caused Phase 30 build failure in CI.
captureConsoleDisabledLevels was passed to Faro as a valid option but doesn't exist in the SDK — caused typecheck failure.
Phase 31 CI lint failure required a separate 'run prettier' fix commit — formatter was not run before committing simplify changes.
pre-existing TypeScript errors in SDK test mocks (client.test.ts deleteItem test missing ipnsControllerUnenrollBatch mock) create noise when running full test suite.

Three separate rounds of CodeRabbit/Copilot reviews on Phase 30 (faro.ts scrubbing) — each round surfacing related-but-distinct privacy issues suggesting the initial implementation lacked a comprehensive privacy threat model.
